# launch-2026-09-30-jxmr — as built

What was actually built, ledger row by ledger row, against the approved plan in
[`KICKOFF.md`](KICKOFF.md) §9. Started 2026-10-03, when the re-planned iteration
moved to `implementing` (first opened 2026-10-01; the Oct 2 drop sent it back to
`planning` before any row was built). `fe-kickoff-iteration` adds one entry as
each row is built and verified.

## AMBER (L-57)

Every AMBER item the plan named — Appendix C.3, the §6 labels (A-L1 … A-L9, A-A1 … A-A5, A-P1,
A-P2, A-F1 … A-F15) and the unlabelled §3 and §6 defaults — and every AMBER default the build took
(the AMBER decisions D39 – D91, D101 – D132 and D142 – D147, the entries' Differences and the
Standing deviations), each with what was built (D34, D90). The Visit sheet's items closed with L-49
(#84), and those about the sheet itself went with it (D99, #89); the theme studio's, the edge
handle's and the centred dialogs' went with the trim and the drawers (D133, D134; #92, #93). None
waits on a build row now.
L-57 is deferred past this iteration with the user's OK (D96): each item keeps its default until its
owner answers. None of them stops the build; each is a default someone has to confirm. A yes
closes it; another answer becomes a decision before L-58, or a `change` / `fix` iteration after it.

**At build:** `as planned` — the plan's default, built · `revised (D…)` — the build changed the
plan's default · `decided (D…)` — a default the build took where the sources were silent · `not
built` · `closed` — settled by the source or a test · `removed (D…)` — the surface it asked about
was removed by a decision.

**Who answers:** Nikunj Mavani (product: behaviour, access, money, privacy) · Design (the designer,
in the next drop: copy, labels, icons, colour and layout the drop leaves open) · clinozy-be (the
contract — each such item is also in [`plans/backend-handoff.md`](plans/backend-handoff.md)) ·
native reviewers (the ten non-English locales).

## Summary

A draft: written at the close's preparation (D95) and kept open by D97. 85 of the 88 planned rows
are `done`; L-57 (the AMBER answers) and L-60 (each room going live) are `deferred` with the user's
OK (D96). The six rows added after approval (› Revisions to upcoming rows) are `done`: the four of
D97 — L-63 and L-64 (#88, #89), then L-62 and L-65 (#90, #91) — then L-66, every modal a drawer
(D133, #92), and L-67, Appearance trimmed to the design and the leftovers pass (D134 – D140, #93).
The close's E2E runs led to five fixes (#94). L-58 — the close — stays `open` until the user has
confirmed the whole build locally, at once, with no pull request before (D97, D141); the final
Summary is written then. L-49's Visit sheet, built in #84, was removed while L-64 was built, by the
user's decision (D99).

Verified before the drawers: the full unit, security and ci-policy run green — 8468 / 8468 at
L-65a's rebase (`ef8eb6d`) and again with coverage on `f7a61ec`, where `pnpm health` passes in every
phase with `build:check`, the size budgets (then Initial JS 246.71 / 247.1 kB, CSS 37.73 / 39.6 kB),
the coverage thresholds (measured 94.87 / 88.54 / 93.17 / 95.78) and patch coverage (96.13%). After
the drawers, the trim and the leftovers: the unit, security and ci-policy run at `dd91ac1` passes
8352 of 8353 — the one failure a timing flake under load, 3 / 3 alone — and the budgets come down to
237 kB JS and 35.9 kB CSS (measured 236.61 and 35.53 kB; #93). The E2E lane, against :5173 and a
clinozy-be run without watch mode, at `a312773`: 270 passed, 5 failed, 1 flaky, 16 skipped — every
non-pass a visual baseline. The runs before it found the helper's 401 race, the 403 spec, the closed
cards' contrast and the doubled offline alert; the lanes' contrast followed, pinned by a new
Today-as-a-Doctor accessibility spec (#94).

**Pending — the lead fills these in at the close:** the final gate run on the tip — unit, security
and ci-policy: _pending_; E2E: _pending_; `pnpm health`: _pending_ — and the visual baselines
re-recorded, the first `today.png` among them (#88): _pending_.

    server — a full run wiped `.vite/deps` under it ("504 Outdated Optimize Dep"); a clinozy-be in
    watch mode restarted 29 times during one E2E run while another session edited it, so the lane
    runs against a backend without watch; the merged agent worktrees are still on disk — the user
    may remove them.
